rec.name: PDP Product Badges (metafield-driven, up to 3)

what.text: A block in the main product section that shows up to three small badges (e.g. 'Bestseller', 'New', 'Limited') directly above the product title on the PDP. Badge text comes from three product metafields, so each product can carry different badges. Each badge has its own text color, border color, background and optional icon. Position, spacing, padding, corner radius and typography are configurable in the theme editor.

why.text: Badges give shoppers an instant cue at the point of decision. 'Bestseller' acts as social proof, 'Limited' adds scarcity or urgency, and 'New' signals relevance. They are scannable, sit next to the title and price, and need no extra reading. Because they are set per product, the cues stay credible and avoid blanket claims. Three styles (solid, outlined, tinted) let the badges be visually ranked.

how.text: 1) In main-product.liquid, add the schema block 'pdp_product_badges' (limit 1). 2) Create the snippet pdp_product_badges.liquid. It renders only if at least one badge metafield is filled. It outputs a flex list of three badge divs (badge_1..3), each with an optional icon image and the metafield text, plus the product title (h1 on the PDP) inside a wrapper whose position class is top-left, top-right or below-title. CSS is injected inline from block settings, with a mobile font-size override at max-width 767px. 3) In product-info.liquid, call {% render 'pdp_product_badges', product: product, block: block %}. 4) Create three single-line-text product metafields: standard.pdp_product_badge_01, _02, _03. 5) Fill the metafields per product and style the block in the theme editor.

items: Space top (0–32px, default 0) and space bottom (0–32px, default 24)
Position: top left / top right / below the title
Top-bottom padding (0–16px, default 4) and left-right padding (0–24px, default 8)
Custom font-family checkbox plus font picker (default Inter)
Text size desktop and mobile (10–18px, default 12)
Per badge 1/2/3: icon image, text color, border color, background (defaults: solid dark, outlined transparent, solid dark)

dependencies.text: Three product metafields (single line text): standard.pdp_product_badge_01, standard.pdp_product_badge_02, standard.pdp_product_badge_03. The theme must have main-product.liquid and a product-info.liquid snippet that renders blocks. The title markup uses the classes product-meta__title heading h3 (Prestige-style theme assumption). No app required. Not built: the original acceptance criteria also asked for presets, tag-based display, stock-based visibility, device visibility toggles and a bold toggle. The delivered code uses metafields instead. Stock logic and tag targeting are absent, and no device toggle exists beyond a separate mobile font size.

items: PDP add-to-cart rate for products with vs. without badges
Conversion rate and revenue per session on tested PDPs
Bestseller or limited-badge products: share of sales vs. baseline
Scroll depth to the buy button

images.caption: Mobile PDP: a single black 'BESTSELLER' badge above the product title, price and tax note.
Close-up of three badges above the title: 'Bestseller' with icon on light grey, 'New' outlined with no icon, 'Limited' with icon on a light peach tint.
Theme editor: the 'PDP | Product Badges' block in the Product page template with its settings panel (space, position, gap, icon, padding, radius, font, size) next to the live preview.
